location: Tram to Springvale Alliance (Eastern Freeway Upgrades), Blackburn North, Melbourne VIC
cover_letter_text:
Hello,
I am applying for the Civil Site Engineer role with the Tram to Springvale Alliance on the Eastern Freeway Upgrades, advertised on SEEK. Your advert lists earthworks, drainage and pavements among the scopes, and monitoring site progress, quality and safety among the tasks.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers each day, tracked progress and carried out site inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I assisted with site inspections and quality checks, tracked procurement and materials, and prepared site reports and progress reports. In February 2026 I completed the Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, where I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019).

I am based in Melton VIC. I can start two weeks after an offer. Full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa), no sponsorship needed. I hold a full Victorian driver's licence and a White Card. Could we arrange a call about the role?
Marc Masarate

Duty overlap 13 of 15. No mandatory bar: skipped on fit only. The letter on file is in the new three-paragraph shape if this is brought back.
